text:
Olga G.: Hey team — quick creative ask for next week's webinar + post-launch followups. Need a compact trifold one-sheet that sales can print and tuck into SDR outbound packs, plus a small sticker-pack (digital and print labels) that maps inbound leads to routing buckets. Goal: one page for exec summary, one panel with benchmark sparkline + 3 callouts, and a backside with handoff checklist.

Tom R.: Love the idea. Do you have copy for the exec summary or should we pull from the webinar slides?

Olga G.: I can drop a draft. Keep it tight, ~45 words. Main hook: "Serving wins: predictable latency, lower cost per token." Then 3 bullets: "Dedicated & private deploys", "Optimized batching & caching", "Transparent unit economics".

Priya S.: For the sticker-pack, can we make 4 color-coded labels: "hot", "warm", "needs-ops", "compliance-review"? Each should include a 1-line routing note and an icon. Print size = 2in x 1in. Digital version needs alt text.

Liam K.: FYI — routing notes need to align with the HubSpot workflow. Sample rule I use:
```
{"if":"lead.score >= 80","route_to":"AE - Enterprise"}
```
Keep the copy short for the sticker (12–15 chars).

DesignBot: Figma file created: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/tri-fold-sdr-pack. Added frame: "A3_print_ready" and sticker artboard with cut guides.

Tom R.: Nice. Olga — can you paste the 45-word summary here so we can start layout? Also confirm brand tone: formal or punchy?

Olga G.: Punchy. Draft: "Redwood Inference makes LLM inference predictable and affordable. Ship reliable AI features with low latency, transparent pricing, and private-deploy options for regulated workloads. Reduce per-token cost with intelligent batching, caching, and quantization — scale without surprises."

Priya S.: Alt text for "hot" sticker: "Hot lead — immediate AE outreach". For compliance: "Requires legal review before demo". I will compile the sticker copy.

Liam K.: One ask from infra — include a tiny diagram (backside panel) showing "Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private" flow with arrows and a tiny latency/cost sparkline under each. Keep it grayscale-friendly for prints.

Tom R.: Design constraints: follow brand palette but ensure sticker contrast meets a11y. Use #0B3D91 for headers, #F5F7FA background for panels. QR code? We can add a small QR that links to the internal routing doc.

Olga G.: Yes add QR. Link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/inbound-routing (use short link for print).

DesignBot: Uploaded initial comps in Figma, left comments on the sparkline spacing and QR margin. Tagging @Tom R., @Priya S., @Liam K. for review.

Tom R.: I'll review comps by EOD and leave exact copy placement notes. If all good, can we get print-ready PDFs by Thursday?

Priya S.: I'll finalize sticker copy and alt text tonight.

Olga G.: Thanks! If anything blocks, ping me here. :thumbsup:
